subject: Nexus now has first non-mock OperationsDisplaySnapshot
body_md: Material implementation update: on `nova/hackathon-convergence-v0` I added `data/operations/current.json` as the first evidence-bearing OperationsDisplaySnapshot. It includes: (1) a GSA federal-acquisition Opportunity Radar record sourced to GSA's Aug. 24/25 AI acquisition events; (2) a geolocated Hormuz Reality Delta preserving the official-vs-commercial throughput measurement conflict; (3) an Orbital Insight rendering of that same verified chokepoint state; (4) a bounded Nova operation record; and (5) an Alternative-Data Alpha Hunter trial comparing commercial vessel tracking against the public official throughput baseline. Important: Wayfinder score fields are deliberately zero/vetoed as NOT_RUN, and the alt-data trial explicitly cannot advance until direct tracker data/methodology is available. No mock telemetry is labeled live. Commit: `c566cda324aff14865c1276f9324077ef5a70d9f`. Current bottleneck is now Wayfinder scoring + Nexus policy/ledger transition, not display-schema design.
